name: Accelerated Learning Program (Badger Precollege)
what_you_do: Two weeks on the UW-Madison campus focused on one college-level course (68 class hours).
who_can_apply: Students finishing grades 9 to 12 from Wisconsin, across the U.S. and abroad. Admission usually looks at advanced coursework, a 3.2 unweighted GPA or similar, and essays. No age range is stated.
pay_detail: 2027: domestic residential $4,500; commuter $2,650; international $4,800; plus a $100 application fee (fee waivers can be requested). Scholarships exist (see notes).
deadline_text: Applications open Jan 12, 2027 and are due May 1, 2027. Courses fill first come, first served.
how_to_apply: Online application with two essays (written or video) and an unofficial transcript.
notes: Full scholarship for Wisconsin residents who get free or reduced lunch; partial scholarship (up to 50%) with income paperwork; none for international students. Funds are limited. The page still shows an April 1, 2026 scholarship date and says three weeks in one spot, so ask. Contact info@precollege.wisc.edu or 608-890-3260.
